corrections.what: Drew the bulb crown as one true circular arc, centre (64.24, 65.44), r 32.48, with each neck a single smooth curve fitted to the sheet's centreline
corrections.why: DR-03. The crown holds the circle within 0.15 px from 130 deg round to 42 deg; the neck curves fit at 0.14 and 0.07 px rms.

corrections.what: Mirrored the four rays' fan about x 64.7: top ray upright, the upper pair at 51 deg either side
corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. The upper rays measure 51.3 and 129.0 deg (black) and their ends mirror about 64.69 to 64.75.

corrections.what: Gave the wire's three bends true arcs (r 9.1, 6.3, 7.7) between straight runs at y 112.27, x 113.44, y 88.41 and x 143.64
corrections.why: DR-03 straight lines and true curves. Runs fit at 0.0 to 0.09 px rms; the bends keep their drawn sizes.

corrections.what: Placed the terminal ring at centre (143.95, 54.05), r 8.6
corrections.why: Black and red sheets disagree by 0.4 px in radius (black r 8.81, red 8.38) and 0.3 px in centre; the trace takes the middle.

source_notes: Kept: four rays, none on the right where the terminal sits; the bulb's right neck stopping short at y 103.9 while the left neck runs down into the base line; the base line continuing as the wire, so bulb and terminal form one connected symbol; the Y filament with its left arm taller than its right, as drawn; the collar whose right side stops just under the base line, and the cup below it. Red: the four rays and the hollow terminal ring; the red sheet shows the ring whole over the wire's end, so the accent group is drawn last.
